module_summary: IP frame arbitrating multiplexer: an arbiter instance grants one of S_COUNT sources, a frame flag latches the granted header into output registers and muxes payload through a skid-buffer output stage.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: In-frame flag: set at header accept, cleared on granted tlast; gates header latch

anchors.name: grant
anchors.why: One-hot grant vector from arbiter; masks requests and drives s_ip_hdr_ready

anchors.name: grant_encoded
anchors.why: Encoded grant index selecting source header fields and payload stream

anchors.name: grant_valid
anchors.why: Arbiter grant valid; enables header accept and payload pass-through

anchors.name: request
anchors.why: Arbiter request vector from header valid masked by current grant

anchors.name: acknowledge
anchors.why: Releases arbiter grant when granted source transfers last payload beat

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Per-source header valid, forms arbiter requests

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Per-source header ready pulsed for granted source at frame start

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output header valid, set when granted header latched

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream header ready; clears header valid and allows next frame

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac_reg
anchors.why: Representative latched header field register held for the frame

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Concatenated source payload data, muxed by grant_encoded

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-source payload valid, selected into output path

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Ready routed only to the granted source

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload data from registered output stage

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from output register

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream payload ready controlling skid buffer transfers

anchors.name: current_s_tdata
anchors.why: Payload data of granted source after mux

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal ready gating input acceptance into output/temp registers

anchors.name: temp_m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp data register used when output stalled

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads muxed payload directly into output registers

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads muxed payload into temp skid registers

anchors.name: store_ip_payload_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves temp skid registers into output registers

groups.name: Arbiter
groups.description: Arbiter instance picks one header-valid source; grant released on last payload beat

groups.name: Frame controller and header latch
groups.description: Frame flag accepts granted header and latches all header fields into output registers

groups.name: Payload mux
groups.description: Selects granted source payload stream by grant_encoded

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Output and temp registers forming a two-entry skid buffer for payload
